title: DC-area forecast: Refreshing again tomorrow before it turns toasty again
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Evening temperatures dip through the 70s and into the 60s. Breezes of the day diminish somewhat with sunset ahead of a clear and crisp night.

What’s next? Beautiful Tuesday. It turns warmer and somewhat more humid midweek. Late in the week, rain chances increase as a cold front approaches.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Clear and cool with diminishing winds. Evening readings fall back through the 70s into the 60s. Overnight lows range from the upper 40s in our colder spots to the upper 50s downtown — probably the coolest since early June. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Tuesday): This is likely the nicest day of the week, with sunny skies and delightfully dry air (dew points near 50). Highs range from the mid-70s to near 80. Confidence: High 😎 Nice Day!

Tomorrow night: Another clear and crisp early fall night. Lows range from the upper 40s in our colder areas to the upper 50s downtown. Confidence: High

❤️ How to support Capital Weather

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Temperatures and humidity slowly increase Wednesday and Thursday as winds start to come in from the south, but neither becomes too extreme. Skies are partly to mostly sunny, with highs in the low to mid-80s Wednesday and mostly in the mid-80s Thursday. Dew points rise from near 60 Wednesday to the mid-60s by Thursday. Lows range from the mid-50s to mid-60s Wednesday night and mostly in the 60s Thursday night. Confidence: Medium-High

A cold front approaches from the northwest and may stall nearby Friday through Sunday, bringing chances for showers and thunderstorms, especially during the afternoon and evening. Otherwise, skies are variably cloudy, with warm and muggy conditions. Highs are in the 80s, with lows in the 60s. Confidence: Low-Medium

DC weather history for September 14

A torrential 1966 downpour set a rainfall record, triggering flash flooding and abruptly ending a drought across the region.

Today’s daily digit — 9/10: Close to perfect with sunshine, dropping humidity, and a refreshing breeze. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
